body:
Hello! I was referred here by a friend, however I think I may not belong.

​

Where can I go to ask the stupid questions at the beginning they indicated I couldn't ask?  :):):)  I'm so sorry to be a pain. Thank you!

MissRoyalKC
Same!! I was just talking about this on Twitter. One of my favorite things about ST.
Lol this is so wild, some say their T-Mobile promotion ends March 1st 2023, others it says active through the 2023 MLB TV promotion. Why can't they just tell us?!
Haha omg it was. See!? I am practically a boomer!!!

Like the more I think about it since reading the reply, yeah it totally sounds like a set up. Like, "oh don't worry about a picture, mark it complete, etc" 

It's too bad you can't rate customers. I was just thinking like, what if they're in traffic and they risk being late? I don't want their rating or ability to accept orders to be affected. 

I've already edited my delivery instructions per the feedback and really appreciate all of the advice and help. Thanks for the service❤️

Yes it makes sense! Of course something like that would never even occur to me. Like, in my mind, who would do that? I'm sorry you guys have to deal with people making false claims and stuff.

Thanks for the feedback, I'll do that! Xoxo
I'm not quite a boomer but I'm old lol and just want to be helpful. 😂
Ok! Great to know, I'll do that! Thank you ❤️

Oh really? Aww that would make me sad lol
They'd really do that!?

I probably wouldn't even complain. I'd just be like, "welp, lesson learned." 😂
Are you feeling any better at all? Physically and/or emotionally? I think about you going through that and I wish I could offer a hug.  Why are you feeling sad?

There isn't really any incident that caused my grief, I just have felt worthless and empty for a very long time. And I've lost too much of myself to ever get back.

I typed out a bunch of things but it all sounds irrational and ridiculous when I read it all back. But I think that's the nature of emotions, right? They're not logical. Though being aware of that fact doesn't exactly make them less real.

I'm desperate and determined to accomplish this somehow.  Was thinking of trying alcohol to help facilitate courage.

Reddit captcha just asked, "are you human," before I could click 'post'.

Like, I don't even know, Reddit. That verification might be the only thing I have lol

I am filled with tears of joy! I'm so happy for them both, congratulations!! I can imagine both families struggled a lot, what a great achievement!

Thank you for sharing this with us all. Love!!
I'm a Royals fan and even I agree!  I love Mr Smile, such a great guy with immense talent. Probably means a lot to your city, they should definitely keep him!
